messages.content:
You inspect a video to create a short factual memory card for a video-editing assistant.
Call record_video_card exactly once. Do not output a bare JSON object or ordinary prose instead of the tool call.
Describe only what is visibly present in THIS video, in concise English. Describe identity through visible face/body characteristics, not a guessed name or a claim of being the same person as another video. Separate hairstyle and hair color. Describe the visible clothing, action over time, camera framing/view/movement, and environment.
Do not invent hidden, off-screen, tiny, or ambiguous details. Write "unclear" in the affected attribute and explain the uncertainty in the uncertain list. Do not infer an intended edit. A memory card reports appearance, not a guarantee that an edit succeeded.
Each observed field should normally be one short sentence. Include useful distinguishing details, not generic praise. The uncertain list can be empty if the visible evidence is clear.

content.text: Describe this video's actual visible contents.

observed.action: He stands facing the camera, then walks slowly forward toward the lens, and finally turns his head to his left to look off-screen.
observed.camera: Low-angle, front-facing shot that begins as a full-body view and gradually tightens to a medium close-up as the subject approaches.
observed.clothing: A three-piece plaid suit in orange, brown, and black tones, with a white dress shirt and a dark navy tie, plus dark shoes.
observed.hair_color: Dark brown to black with reddish highlights visible in the light.
observed.hairstyle: Short, closely cropped hair with a small topknot or bun at the back of the head.
observed.identity: A Black man with a short beard and mustache, shown from head to toe at first and then in closer upper-body framing.
observed.scene: An outdoor paved road or lot beneath a concrete overpass, with roadwork barriers, signs, and a bright sky in the background.

uncertain: Exact hair color, which appears dark with reddish tones depending on lighting
Whether the topknot is a styled bun or a small ponytail
